#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
import re,sys
from pathlib import Path
root,dst,report=map(Path,sys.argv[1:4]);strip=False;changed=[]
dst.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.txt'),key=lambda p:p.relative_to(root).as_posix()):
    if not p.is_file():continue
    original=p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8');text=original
    if text.startswith('\ufeff'):text=text[1:]
    text=text.replace('\r\n','\n')
    if strip:text=re.sub(r'[ \t]+(?=\n|$)','',text)
    rel=p.relative_to(root);target=dst/rel;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(text.encode('utf-8'))
    if text!=original:changed.append(rel.as_posix())
report.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);report.write_text(''.join(p+'\n' for p in changed))
PY
